label: Bank of Canada Valet
terms_note: Open data under the Bank of Canada terms (https://www.bankofcanada.ca/terms/), no key. The docs page is a Swagger UI whose OpenAPI 3 YAML is chosen in JavaScript by language: https://www.bankofcanada.ca/valet/static/swagger/api-en.yml (English) and api-fr.yml (French); the forge's link finder cannot see that URL (it is built from a template in swagger-initializer.js). Observations are keyed by series name: {"d": date, "<series>": {"v": value}}. Unknown series: 404 {"message":"Series NOPEX not found."} (live 2026-10-01).

search_symbols.note: Every Valet series (about 15,000: exchange rates FX..., bond yields, BCPI ...); query matches the name, label or description; paged locally from one cached download.

get_series.note: series_id is one Valet series name, e.g. FXUSDCAD (daily USD/CAD), V39079 (overnight target rate). start/end are YYYY-MM-DD; without them the whole history is returned.

not_offered.get_news: Only an FX RSS feed (/fx_rss), not news; not mapped.

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
